dedupe_keys.name: open modeling framework for power systems

description: The Open Modeling Framework is NRECA's Python modelling suite for studying power-system behaviour and the costs and benefits of emerging technologies. It includes circuit editing and decision models for distributed generation, storage, hosting capacity, voltage, outages and related financial analysis. Users supply network, equipment, load and economic assumptions; outputs include engineering results, graphs and cost comparisons. Geographic and temporal coverage depend on the configured study. Public source and local installation are free under GPL-2.0, while the hosted service requires an account. A limitation is that its many models use different assumptions and underlying tools, so a common interface does not establish equivalent fidelity across analyses. Local deployment and model dependencies must be checked. OMF can support distribution investment and resilience simulations, complementary to system-level PyPSA (model-pypsa). Its public documentation indexes individual decision models and installation procedures. No hosted account, utility network or external solver was accessed.
name: Open Modeling Framework for power systems
